_comment: Source of truth for user-scope MCP servers: only what the claude.ai connectors can't provide. install.sh/install.ps1 registers each via 'claude mcp add-json -s user', skipping (and unregistering) a server whose stdio command isn't installed or whose ${VAR} is empty in secrets.env. NO SECRETS HERE — values come from secrets.env (gitignored) at launch. See .env.example. github takes a PAT: its OAuth server has no dynamic client registration.
_retired_comment: Unregistered by the installers; each comes from its claude.ai connector instead. Slack's MCP needs a registered Slack app; Vercel and Notion are the same servers as their connectors, minus a per-machine login; aws-mcp needed uvx and AWS credentials on every machine.
